sources.use_and_scope: Source of the motivating biased quantum-clock architecture, existing exponential precision–entropy advantage, and five-level thermal interface. The main text and relevant Methods were inspected. The full microscopic supplementary derivation is not reproduced here.

sources.citation_markdown: Florian Philippe Meier, **Quantum limits in timekeeping**, doctoral dissertation, TU Wien (2026). [Institutional PDF](https://repositum.tuwien.at/bitstream/20.500.12708/228728/1/Meier%20Florian%20Philippe%20-%202026%20-%20Quantum%20limits%20in%20timekeeping.pdf).
sources.use_and_scope: Section 2.2.2, printed pages 49–50, discusses quantum reset clocks and the conjectured extension of an exponential semi-Markov thermodynamic uncertainty relation. The single-pair ceiling proved here does not settle the thesis's more general or sharp conjecture.

sources.citation_markdown: Daniel Holst, Gianmichele Blasi and Shishir Khandelwal, **Non-Markovian exceptional points and information backflow: a Heisenberg reaction-coordinate approach**, arXiv:2610.26620v1 (19 October 2026). sources.use_and_scope: Section VIII.1 and Appendix H derive the maximal-exceptional-point Erlang escape law under terminal irreversible loss. Section IX discusses autonomous recycling as a possible extension. This mechanism is inherited; the finite-reverse-rate bounds in this repository are separately derived.

sources.citation_markdown: Kay Brandner and Keiji Saito, **Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relations for Coherent Transport**, *Physical Review Letters* **135**, 046302 (2025). [DOI:10.1103/6nww-8wcp](https://doi.org/10.1103/6nww-8wcp) · [arXiv:2502.07917v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.07917v2).
sources.use_and_scope: An exponential uncertainty relation for coherent fermionic transport. The inspected proof uses the Landauer scattering setting; its hypotheses differ from a single excitation reset after every counted jump.

sources.use_and_scope: The comparison here concerns the quantities entering the general precision bounds, including total entropy and additional trajectory information. No argument relies on an unexamined exact formula in the erratum.

sources.use_and_scope: Equation (51), the steady-state examples and the reset-process appendix retain a dynamics-dependent quantum correction. They do not immediately give the affinity-only ceiling used here.
